title: Company settings
ownerApprovalDescription: Owner approval is on by default. Each owner's choice is recorded at onboarding and can be changed per property.
invalidName: Enter a name of 2 to 120 characters.
invalidLicence: Enter a trade licence number of 1 to 40 characters.
invalidTrn: Enter exactly 15 digits for the TRN, or leave it empty.
VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this company while you were working. Reload to see the latest settings.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to change company settings.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the company details and try again.
SESSION_INVALID: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
UNAVAILABLE: We could not load or save company settings. Check your connection and try again.
